summary: CAE Inc. filed a Form 6-K on June 22, 2026, furnishing its Notice and Management Proxy Circular dated June 11, 2026, and its Annual Report for the year ended March 31, 2026. This is a routine submission of governance and financial disclosure materials for the upcoming Annual Shareholders Meeting. The filing contains no M&A, activist, restructuring, or other special-situation activity; it is purely a scheduled periodic report and proxy statement. Accordingly, no special situation event is triggered.
